entry.title: Mongoose: sanitizeFilter not applied on countDocuments (CVE-2026-125120)
entry.content:
vulnerability · query-injection · CVE-2026-125120

Mongoose versions prior to 9.9.2, 8.24.3, 7.8.12, and 6.13.11 lack `sanitizeFilter` protection on `countDocuments()` queries, enabling query selector injection attacks. This critical vulnerability allows attackers to bypass input validation and inject malicious query selectors when counting documents. The flaw is confirmed exploitable in production environments. Immediately upgrade Mongoose to patched versions (9.9.2+, 8.24.3+, 7.8.12+, or 6.13.11+) depending on your major version line; if immediate patching is not feasible, implement middleware-based input sanitization as a temporary workaround.

entry.title: node-opcua: Namespace-Level RBAC Fail-Open - Anonymous Write/Call Bypass via Unbound `DefaultRolePermissions (CVE-2026-95860)
entry.content:
vulnerability · auth-bypass · CVE-2026-95860

node-opcua and related packages (node-opcua-address-space, node-opcua-server) fail to enforce role-based access control (RBAC) at the namespace level, allowing unauthenticated clients to write protected variables and call privileged methods on nodes lacking explicit per-node permissions. The vulnerability stems from improper handling of DefaultRolePermissions inheritance; the implementation grants access instead of applying the required default-deny policy specified in OPC UA Part 3. Severity is critical with no indication of active exploitation reported. Immediately patch to the latest version and review OPC UA server configurations to ensure explicit RolePermissions are defined on sensitive nodes as a temporary mitigation.

Read more · Source: github-advisories

entry.title: bitcoinjs-lib: Undetected merkle node duplication in block root computation validates a forged transaction list (CVE-2026-107846)
entry.content:
vulnerability · merkle-tree-collision · CVE-2026-107846

The bitcoinjs-lib npm package contains a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-107846) in its merkle root computation where `fastMerkleRoot` silently pads odd-level nodes by self-hashing without indication, allowing attackers to duplicate transactions while maintaining an identical merkle root and block hash. This enables forged transaction lists to pass validation since `checkTxRoots` does not detect repeated transactions, and the block header retains valid proof-of-work. There is no indication of active wild exploitation. Affected applications should immediately update bitcoinjs-lib to a patched version that properly detects and rejects duplicate transactions in merkle tree construction.

vulnerability · sandbox-escape · CVE-2026-44267

The npm @enspirit/elo package contains a critical sandbox escape vulnerability (CVE-2026-44267) allowing unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary Node.js or browser JavaScript code by exploiting unfiltered `.constructor` member access in the Elo language parser and emitter. An attacker controlling input to `defaultFormats.elo.parse()`, the `bin/elo` CLI tool, or the online playground can craft payloads using `.constructor.constructor` chains to compile directly into `Function` invocations, completely bypassing the language's intended sandboxing. This vulnerability is critical severity; no evidence of active wild exploitation is mentioned but the attack requires only string control, making it highly exploitable. Developers using Elo should immediately update to a patched version once available and avoid processing untrusted Elo code; the online playground should be considered unsafe until patched.

entry.title: imgproxy has integer overflow in imgproxy ICO loader that causes denial of service and may permit remote code execution
entry.content:
vulnerability · integer-overflow

imgproxy ICO image loader contains an integer overflow vulnerability in heap allocation when processing attacker-controlled 32-bit data size values. When data_size exceeds UINT32_MAX minus BMP_FILE_HEADER_LEN, the allocation wraps to a smaller buffer, followed by heap overflow during write operations. This critical vulnerability affects imgproxy v1, v2, and v3, and can be exploited remotely via malicious ICO files to cause denial of service or achieve remote code execution. Immediately patch to the latest patched version; if immediate patching is unavailable, disable or restrict ICO image processing.

entry.title: zip: Critical Parser Differential & Security Control Bypass via Dual-Header Inconsistencies (Zip Cloaking) Leading to Arbitrary File Overwrite & RCE (CVE-2026-115905)
entry.content:
vulnerability · parser-differential · CVE-2026-115905

The Rust `zip` crate (versions ≤9.0.4) contains a critical parser differential vulnerability (CVE-2026-115905) where `ZipArchive` and `ZipStreamReader` interpret filenames differently—the former trusts the Central Directory File Header while the latter relies on the Local File Header. Attackers can craft malicious ZIP archives with inconsistent headers to achieve arbitrary file overwrites and remote code execution, exploiting this inconsistency to bypass security controls. This vulnerability is critical severity; no active exploitation in the wild has been confirmed at time of advisory. Immediately update to `zip` version >9.0.4 and validate all ZIP extraction logic, particularly any code using `ZipStreamReader`.

The vulnerability exploited Android's intent-based app communication model, enabling token theft without requiring any special permissions. Microsoft patched the issue in Authenticator version 6.2606.4246; immediate update is recommended for all Android users as the flaw poses severe risk to enterprise account security.

entry.content:
vulnerability · memory-corruption

A critical vulnerability in Brotli, the C decoder library integrated into Node.js, allows remote attackers to corrupt memory and potentially access sensitive data through malformed HTTP/2 requests. The flaw, tracked as HTTP2Shell, affects Node.js versions that bundle the vulnerable Brotli decoder and has been reported as exploited in active attacks. Apply emergency patches immediately to affected Node.js installations, prioritizing systems handling untrusted HTTP/2 traffic. Verify Brotli library updates are applied across all dependent applications and runtimes.

entry.title: Hackers Infect 953 Online Stores With Scanner-Evading JavaScript, Mostly on Magento
entry.content:
red-team · malware-injection

A threat actor has compromised 953 e-commerce stores, predominantly Magento installations, injecting malicious JavaScript through CMS blocks since July 2025 to serve scanner-evading loader code to visitors. The attack exploits Magento vulnerabilities or weak access controls to inject persistent malicious code designed to evade security scanning tools, likely for credential theft or payment card skimming. This represents an active, ongoing campaign affecting a large merchant base with moderate-to-high severity due to potential customer data compromise. Affected Magento administrators should immediately audit CMS block contents, apply available security patches, enforce strong access controls, implement Web Application Firewall rules to detect injected JavaScript, and conduct forensic analysis of compromised stores.

entry.title: uCreator Android Spyware Can Steal Telegram 2FA Passwords and Clone WeChat Accounts
entry.content:
red-team · spyware

uCreator is an Android spyware kit distributed through sideloaded, modified versions of Telegram and WeChat outside official app stores. The malware intercepts 2FA codes and account credentials, enabling account takeover and cloning of both messaging platforms. While currently limited in reach due to reliance on sideloaded distribution, this represents a significant threat to users of these widely-used communications platforms. Mitigation: Install only official Telegram and WeChat from Google Play Store, avoid sideloading apps, and enable additional account security measures such as two-factor authentication through official channels.

entry.title: Unpatched Tailscale SSH Flaws Could Let a Hacked Device Reach Root on Other Servers
entry.content:
vulnerability · privilege-escalation

Tailscale SSH implementation contains privilege escalation vulnerabilities allowing compromised network devices to gain root access on target servers when SSH port forwarding is enabled. An attacker with control of one permitted device can exploit flaws in Tailscale's access controls to escalate privileges and laterally move across the network. Severity is high given the requirement for only network access and the resulting full system compromise, though exploitation requires prior device compromise. Users should immediately disable SSH port forwarding in Tailscale security policies if not operationally required, and apply available security patches when released; review network segmentation and device access controls to limit lateral movement potential.

entry.title: BlackX UEFI bootkit exploits Baton Drop flaw to bypass Secure Boot
entry.content:
red-team · secure-boot-bypass

BlackX UEFI bootkit exploits CVE-2021-21224 (Baton Drop), a Secure Boot bypass flaw in certain firmware implementations, to load malicious drivers targeting Kaspersky and Avast security solutions. The vulnerability is critical as it completely circumvents Secure Boot protections; exploitation is confirmed active in espionage campaigns as of early 2026. Affected organizations should immediately verify UEFI firmware versions and apply available security updates from their OEM, while considering additional endpoint detection and response (EDR) solutions to compensate for compromised security products. Forensic investigation of systems with unusual UEFI modifications is recommended to detect potential BlackX deployment.

entry.title: Echo: Rejected WebSocket upgrades can bypass Echo route-level access controls
entry.content:
vulnerability · auth-bypass

Echo web framework versions 4 and 5 contain a critical vulnerability in the Proxy middleware where rejected WebSocket upgrades bypass route-level access controls. When an upstream server rejects a WebSocket upgrade but maintains the connection, subsequent HTTP requests are tunneled directly without passing through Echo's router or middleware, potentially circumventing authentication and authorization checks. This is actively exploitable and affects any Echo application using the Proxy middleware with route-level security controls. Users should immediately upgrade to patched versions of echo/v4 and echo/v5 and review any proxied traffic for potential unauthorized access.

entry.title: Laravel TokenGuard authentication bypass through non-string API credentials (CVE-2026-114509)
entry.content:
vulnerability · auth-bypass · CVE-2026-114509

Laravel's TokenGuard authentication mechanism contains a critical bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-114509) affecting token-based API authentication, particularly on MySQL/MariaDB databases. By submitting specially crafted non-string credential values, attackers can exploit type juggling in authentication queries to authenticate as arbitrary users without valid API tokens. This vulnerability is critical severity; current exploitation status in the wild is not specified in the advisory. Affected Laravel installations using TokenGuard with standard API authentication should immediately update the framework to the patched version and review access logs for suspicious authentication attempts.

entry.title: Wasmtime: Bit-packing in Cranelift compiler causes silent overflow and miscompilation (CVE-2026-115889)
entry.content:
vulnerability · miscompilation · CVE-2026-115889, CVE-2026-115893

Wasmtime versions prior to v43 contain a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-115889) in the Cranelift compiler backend where bit-packing of SSA value indices causes silent overflow in release builds, leading to incorrect IR value references and arbitrary miscompilation. A specially crafted WebAssembly function with excessive SSA values can trigger type confusion and sandbox escape. Update Wasmtime to v43 or later immediately, which remediates the issue by using full u32 indices instead of bit-packed values. No evidence of wild exploitation currently reported, but the critical severity and sandbox escape potential warrant emergency patching.
